draft.subject: Your notification badge ticket + a first project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks again for the kickoff last week. Your ticket about the notification bell badge that never clears is still open on my side, and I'll keep you posted as we work through it.

In the meantime, the piece that usually makes Wrenfield click is getting a first project in place -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to set one up and go through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
